> Run `redis-cli ping` on the server first.

If you do not get `PONG`, Redis is not running or not reachable, so start it or fix the host and port. If you do get `PONG`, the service is fine and the problem is in your configuration: a missing password, the wrong host or port in `wp-config.php`, a missing PHP redis extension, the wrong scheme for a socket connection, or a memory policy refusing writes. Check them in that order.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/error-establishing-a-redis-connection/
